storeInfo.name: Priory Brewing Company
storeInfo.tagline: Handmade Craft Beer & Artisan Fare in Willington, CT

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Una mezcla cautivadora de lúpulos Citra, Magnum y Mosaico que crea un cuerpo atractivo con aroma tropical. ¡Fácil de perdonar por darte un gusto!
products.descriptionEn: Easily forgiven for indulging in a session with the alluring blend of Citra, Magnum & Mosaic hops. Tropical aroma with a refreshing body. 35 IBU.

products.nameEs: Original Sin - IPA Doble Seco (5.5% ABV)
products.nameEn: Original Sin - Double Dry-Hopped IPA (5.5% ABV)
products.descriptionEs: Una trinidad de lúpulos Magnum, Citra y Mosaic que se combinan para crear tonos cítricos, tropicales y afrutados con una base de malta celestial.
products.descriptionEn: A Trinity of Magnum, Citra & Mosaic hops blend together to create citrus, tropical, fruity tones with four different grains for a malty background. 49.2 IBU.

products.descriptionEs: Imposible resistirse al tentador aroma tropical creado por la unión de lúpulos Citra y Mosaic. Amargor suave y cuerpo hermoso. ¡Malvadamente buena!
products.descriptionEn: Impossible to resist the tempting tropical aroma created by the union of Citra and Mosaic hops. Smooth bitterness and beautiful body. 75 IBU.

products.descriptionEs: Un porter tradicional con aromas a café y notas de cacao y caramelo. Elaborado con 6 granos y lúpulos East Kent Goldings. ¡Todos perdonados!
products.descriptionEn: A traditional plain porter with aromas of coffee and hints of cocoa and caramel. Brewed with 6 grains and East Kent Goldings hops. 38 IBU.

products.nameEs: Pretzels Calientes con Queso de Cerveza
products.nameEn: Warm Bavarian Pretzels with Beer Cheese
products.descriptionEn: Bake-to-order pretzels served warm with coarse salt and our creamy cheddar cheese dip infused with Original Sin IPA.
Crispy chicken wings tossed in our house-made sweet and savory BBQ glaze crafted with Plenary Indulgence Porter.
Hand-cut french fries topped with crisp bacon, green onions, melted cheddar cheese, and a dollop of garlic sour cream.

products.nameEs: Hamburguesa Priory con Queso Cheddar Dublín
products.nameEn: Priory Pub Burger with Dublin Cheddar
products.descriptionEn: Juicy Angus beef patty topped with aged Irish cheddar, smoked bacon, crisp lettuce, tomato, and caramelized onion mayo on a brioche bun.
Fresh cod fillet dipped in our Venial Sin beer batter, fried golden and crispy. Served with french fries and house tartar sauce.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pollo a la Plancha con Hierbas
products.descriptionEn: Marinated grilled chicken breast topped with fresh avocado, provolone cheese, baby spinach, and herb aioli on toasted ciabatta.
Tender lamb simmered slowly with potatoes, carrots, onions, and fresh herbs in a rich broth infused with our signature Porter.

products.nameEs: Salchichas Artesanales con Puré de Papas (Bangers & Mash)
products.descriptionEn: Artisanal pork bangers served atop creamy garlic mashed potatoes, smothered in a rich, savory caramelized onion gravy.
Freshly squeezed homemade lemonade infused with a delicate touch of wild lavender syrup. Refreshing and floral.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos varias opciones vegetarianas y platos que se pueden adaptar según sus necesidades dietéticas. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer several vegetarian options and dishes that can be adapted to your dietary needs. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEs: ¿Aceptan reservaciones o es por orden de llegada?
faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations or are you walk-in only?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y también aceptamos reservaciones por teléfono para grupos de cualquier tamaño.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and also accept phone reservations for parties of any size.

faqs.qEs: ¿Permiten niños y familias en la cervecería?
faqs.qEn: Are children and families allowed at the brewery?
faqs.aEs: ¡Por supuesto! Somos un restaurante y cervecería familiar. Contamos con un menú infantil disponible.
faqs.aEn: Absolutely! We are a family-friendly restaurant and brewery. We have a kid's menu available upon request.
